scope: Fresh CPU-only same-Mac verification of tracked source and recorded observations; no new inference and no second-machine reproduction.

resources.measurements: Per-command elapsed wall time, CPU time and wait4 ru_maxrss are in COMMANDS.json. macOS reports ru_maxrss in bytes; these are observed costs, not minimum requirements or performance comparisons.
resources.execution: Commands and frozen analyzers were run sequentially. No accelerator, model/service call, model download, pip install or native build was run.

isolation_boundary: Verification entry points use -I -B. A separate child-style environment probe intentionally omits -I. Unmodified reanalyze.py does not propagate -I to its child processes. Children use the same fresh no-pip virtual environment, sanitized environment, and its explicit analysis-source cwd for module lookup. The virtual environment excludes system site-packages and user site-packages; no third-party distributions are installed. This is environment isolation, not a network or OS security sandbox.

path_placeholders.{REPO}: Existing Git repository used only as tracked snapshot input and destination for new verification files.
path_placeholders.{BUNDLE}: Safely extracted pinned historical mini-jev bundle.
path_placeholders.{REPLAY}: New replay output directory outside the frozen bundle.
path_placeholders.{HOST_HOME}: Sanitized host-home prefix, when present in toolchain paths.

limits: Existing host Python and optional Node executables were reused; this is not a fresh machine or cross-platform validation.
Numerical replay reuses historical observations and does not establish measurement validity, model generalization, or human usability.
Runtime, model and native packaging tests are outside this CPU-only scope.
No package installation, external network/service operation, model loading or inference was part of these commands. Network access was not disabled at OS level.
